@KiaraGrouwstra it seems imports have been failing with ES gateway timeouts since this change - do you want to look into that or should we revert?

> @KiaraGrouwstra it seems imports have been failing with ES gateway timeouts since this change - do you want to look into that or should we revert?

as per the [runner memory limit](https://github.com/NixOS/nixos-search/actions/runs/24744451084/job/72392395595#step:4:28883) exceeded it's looking like either revert or upgrade runner.

> > @KiaraGrouwstra it seems imports have been failing with ES gateway timeouts since this change - do you want to look into that or should we revert?
> 
> as per the [runner memory limit](https://github.com/NixOS/nixos-search/actions/runs/24744451084/job/72392395595#step:4:28883) exceeded it's looking like either revert or upgrade runner.

Where do you see an indication that the runner memory limit was exceeded? My impression is that the relevant log line is:

```
2026-04-21T20:42:27.8849557Z [2026-04-21T20:42:27Z WARN  flake_info::elastic]   Item 0: status 429, type: circuit_breaking_exception, reason: [parent] Data too large, data for [indices:data/write/bulk[s]] would be [8021538190/7.4gb], which is larger than the limit of [7817763225/7.2gb], real usage: [7994148136/7.4gb], new bytes reserved: [27390054/26.1mb], usages [request=0/0b, fielddata=1180235/1.1mb, in_flight_requests=27390054/26.1mb, accounting=35145856/33.5mb]
```

I _think_ that means the ES index is full and we could perhaps do some manual cleanup to remove old versions.

okay, if that'd work that'd be great.

fwiw, as per (noogle.dev-creator) @hsjobeki using ES may be a weird fit for nixos-search anyway, as it's aimed at indexing natural language (involving dealing with declensions) whereas our domain is more exact - which may also be why [NüschtOS Search](https://search.nüschtos.de/) ([source](https://github.com/NuschtOS/search)) managed to pull off a more responsive UX.

> okay, if that'd work that'd be great.

Would that be something you could look into?

> fwiw, as per (noogle.dev-creator) @hsjobeki using ES may be a weird fit for nixos-search anyway, as it's aimed at indexing natural language (involving dealing with declensions) whereas our domain is more exact

Could be, not sure.

> which may also be why [https://search.nüschtos.de/](https://search.n%C3%BCschtos.de/) managed to pull off a nicer UX.

I like nüschtos and I've been in touch with them to see if we could share efforts somehow - either sharing some parts or replacing search.nixos.org with the nüschtos code outright. From memory, while it's really impressive how they packed their search in such a small index so that it can happen client-side, they're indexing way fewer fields than the current search.nixos.org does - and if we'd use the nüschtos approach but index all those other fields that'd grow the index beyond what's reasonable to ship to the client. I'm still interested but didn't see any good opportunities to share without sacrificing functionality.

Note that we recently formulated the direction of all our documentation.

https://github.com/NixOS/nix.dev/blob/c0115f924f2c2a9c34550a7c5dfaac36b91c7cd8/maintainers/vision.md


If there are quick wins for the search i'm supporting that. Sharing infrastructure with nüscht search for a temporary phase until we have the unified portal. 

Now that we have the vision, and hopefully everyone kind of agrees on that, we should all meet and break it down into a roadmap items. In my idea the core is the data model and some thin layered fancy frontend that we can swap out anytime.

> Note that we recently formulated the direction of all our documentation.
> 
> https://github.com/NixOS/nix.dev/blob/c0115f924f2c2a9c34550a7c5dfaac36b91c7cd8/maintainers/vision.md

Sounds good! One thing I'm not seeing here is if searching for 3rd-party flakes (https://search.nixos.org/flakes) is considered in scope for this new search.

> If there are quick wins for the search i'm supporting that.

I don't see any quick wins here.

> Sharing infrastructure with nüscht search for a temporary phase until we have the unified portal.

I'm not sure what you mean here.

> Now that we have the vision, and hopefully everyone kind of agrees on that, we should all meet and break it down into a roadmap items. In my idea the core is the data model and some thin layered fancy frontend that we can swap out anytime.

I personally don't have the bandwidth for any substantial development.
